errors.text_span: 竖直轴表示数值，带有线性的刻度，标签为“每日新增病例数”
errors.evidence: The vertical axis includes both daily new cases and media report counts, but the description only mentions daily new cases.
The description does not mention the right y-axis which represents the number of news reports.
The legend description is incorrect; it states '该国全球确诊数量', which is not accurate as it represents global cases, not specific to a country.
The description does not clearly state that the chart shows trends in both daily new COVID-19 cases and related news reports.
